name: Single-disc
blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.4: fixes a hang in Cosmo Canyon's WHITE2 (#643) where a scripted movie no longer plays correctly on the single-disc build. Retains all v0.2.3 fixes (D1->D2 transition, LOST2 background corruption, Makou Reactor save). Manip movies and endings are disabled pending re-validation on this new base.
hint: CSR. Fields-only core; movies/endings not yet re-enabled.
betaNote: v0.2.4: fixes a hang in Cosmo Canyon's WHITE2 (#643) -- that field plays two short movies, but on the single-disc build they no longer point at valid movie data, so the game freezes trying to play them (screen glitches / stutters to a stop). The movie-playing part of that field's script is removed; the scene now fades to black and continues instead of trying to play the broken movies. Also removed a leftover one-byte patch in LOST2 (#634) that testing showed does nothing on this build -- the earlier field already sets the game up so LOST2's condition is already true, so the patch had no effect on gameplay. Retains all v0.2.3 fixes (D1->D2 transition, LOST2 background corruption, Makou Reactor save). Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
